body:
`better-auth-rs generate --plugins api-key` (and `all`) emits an `api_keys` table with a `user_id` column and no `config_id` (`crates/schema-registry/src/lib.rs`, pinned by `tests/fixtures/cli/{sqlx,seaorm}_all.rs`).

The SQLx/SeaORM stores read and write `reference_id` and `config_id` (`crates/sqlx/migrations/*.sql` has the correct DDL).

**Repro:** generate with `--plugins api-key`, run `run_app_migrations`, sign up, `POST /api-key/create` → empty `500`. Debug log shows `INSERT INTO "api_keys" (…, "reference_id", "config_id", …)` against a table without those columns.

**Expected:** registry columns match the store (`reference_id TEXT NOT NULL`, `config_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default'`); update the CLI fixtures.
title: CLI: generated api_keys table uses user_id and lacks config_id; API key creation fails
